top_choice_rationale: P001 honours an original, checkable prediction (Bistritzer-MacDonald 2011, flat bands at a magic angle) and the decisive 2018 experiment finding correlated insulating and superconducting states at that angle, since reproduced by many independent groups, with twist angle opening a new regime of electron physics. The citation can be kept narrow, claiming the prediction and the discovery of the phases but not the pairing mechanism. The third seat (Andrei's earlier STM work, the 2018 first authors and the Dean and Kim hBN work) remains the weak point but is defensible. P002 is a mature, cross-laboratory verified invention but a refinement of earlier precision-metrology prizes, so it ranks second. No award ranks last because at least one mature, experimentally verified proposal is available.
